blocks.text: Rain fell across much of South Korea on Sunday, the first day of November, while snow was reported in the mountainous areas of Gangwon Province amid chilly temperatures nationwide. According to the Korea Meteorological Administration, rain began falling across central regions early in the morning, while rain or snow was reported in mountainous areas of Gangwon Province at elevations of 1,200 meters or higher, including around Balwangsan in Pyeongchang, which rises to 1,459 meters above sea level. Rain is expected to spread to southern regions and Jeju Island in the afternoon. READ: Early winter chill grips South Korea Showers are forecast […]...
